title.zh: Block brings Bitcoin Lightning payments to x402 for AI agents
title.en: Block brings Bitcoin Lightning payments to x402 for AI agents

current_state.zh: Block has joined the x402 Foundation and integrated Bitcoin Lightning into the x402 open payment standard, positioning Lightning as the low-cost, high-volume settlement layer for autonomous AI agent commerce alongside backers including Google, Microsoft, AWS, Coinbase and the Solana Foundation.
current_state.en: Block has joined the x402 Foundation and integrated Bitcoin Lightning into the x402 open payment standard, positioning Lightning as the low-cost, high-volume settlement layer for autonomous AI agent commerce alongside backers including Google, Microsoft, AWS, Coinbase and the Solana Foundation.
